title: Breeze Rod Recipe
description: Adds a breeze rod crafting recipe with a wind charge and blaze rod
body:
This datapack adds a simple shapeless crafting recipe for breeze rods. 
Costs 1 blaze rod and 1 wind charge to be more balanced.
